section_summary.extract_value: This section details the methodology of a single study involving 82 participants (55 female, 27 male) with a mean age of 23.5 years. Participants completed computerized questionnaire measures of self-evaluation (RSES, SLCS-R), self-deception (SDE subscale of BIDR), and personality (Big Five Inventory) as part of a larger battery of assessments. The section also notes a high correlation (r = .80) between two scoring methods for SDE.
